message:
I couldn't finish this: the `nickname` column needs a new migration, and migrations are fenced off.

I changed `src/api/users.js`:
- `createUser` now accepts an optional `nickname`, defaulting to `null`.
- `getUser` now returns `nickname`, with `null` when it isn't set.

I tried to add `migrations/003_add_nickname.js`, which would contain `exports.up = (db) => db.addColumn('users', 'nickname');`. A Fenceline rule blocked the write: "migrations: off-limits (the DBA team owns them)". I haven't tried to get around it.

I also haven't run `npm test`. Until the column exists, `createUser` will throw `unknown column users.nickname`. That means `test/users-nickname.test.js` still fails, and `test/users.test.js` probably does too.

Do you want to allow me to add `migrations/003_add_nickname.js`, or should the DBA team add the column? Either way, the code change in `src/api/users.js` should work once the column exists. I'll run `npm test` once that's done.
